known_legacy_false_attributions.mechanism: The legacy pattern '^[+-]\s+- id: (\S+)' matched an ADDED BLANK LINE (a diff line that is just '+') whose \s+ class spanned the newline into the CONTEXT id line '   - id: T2.42' below it, under re.MULTILINE. The commit flipped T2.41 to complete and never touched T2.42; the span attribution names T2.41 and not T2.42.
